in popularity in the last century that it
can be difficult to purchase.  The reason
for this decline is not known but may be
its increased toughness with larger sizes.
Kohlrabi leaves are similar to collard greens
or kale in flavor.  The succulent, tender
leaves of young kohlrabi plants can be
cooked like spinach or mustard greens.
Nutrient composition
Kohlrabi is high in vitamin C.  Raw
kohlrabi is a good source of fiber.  Both
raw and cooked forms also contain
antioxidants and bioflavonoids.
